overal.goal: Owner decision needed first. A finished task's last pipeline step has no end time, so the step strip shows no duration for it (phase 3 ruling). Option: the pipeline appends a closing entry to the task's steps[] (for example label 'Finished', 'Failed' or 'Stopped' with its time) when a run ends, and the UI uses it as the last step's end. This is a server change beyond the owner's answer B in the redesign spec, so ask before building.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI (shadcn/ui on Tailwind v4), vitest

rules.do: Read README.md, docs/boof-runner.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-27-ui-redesign-design.md before changing code.
Write a failing test first where the change is logic (src/lib, server); keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npx prettier --check . && npx vitest run && npm run build:server` before finishing.
Ask the owner to approve the server change before writing code.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Raised by the phase 3 final review on 2026-10-29; waiting on the owner.

D8 (owner, 2026-10-29): approved — the pipeline appends a closing steps[] entry (Finished / Failed / Stopped with its time) when a run ends; the UI uses it for the last step's duration. No longer waiting on the owner.
The pipeline appends a closing steps[] entry (Finished, Failed or Stopped) when a run ends, once; stepStrip uses it as the last role's end, and keeps null for tasks without one.

tests.strategy: Store and engine tests that the closing entry is written once per run end; the step strip test for the last role's duration.
